name: token-usage-monitor
description: Track Codex token activity and rate-limit resets locally in real time.

interface.shortDescription: Track token activity, limits, and resets locally.
interface.longDescription: A privacy-focused local monitor for Codex token activity, daily history, rate-limit windows, reset credits, and threshold notifications. It stores usage metadata only and never stores prompt or response text.
defaultPrompt: Show my current token usage and rate limits.
Summarize my token usage for the last 7 days.
Check whether I received an extra rate-limit reset.
